tools.name: track_record
tools.description: What this scanner has called and what became of it: closed calls per chain with the share that doubled and rugged, the lift against pools that traded and were never called, the outcome of every score band including the ones that do not separate, and what its research engine has refuted. Free, and published failures included. Read this before acting on anything else here.

tools.name: open_calls
tools.description: Every call the scanner has open on Arc right now, with what was known when each was opened: entry price, score and the reasons the gate fired, the pool's liquidity and age, the return so far, the sell-test verdict already published for the token, and the Hyperliquid market at that moment. A record of what was flagged, not a recommendation. Paid per call.

tools.name: token_microstructure
tools.description: One Arc token's first hour of trading, frozen while it still existed: how many trades and distinct buyers, dollars through the pool, the largest single buy, what share of the money was three wallets, and the price at ten, thirty and sixty minutes. The chain's public nodes prune this within days, so it cannot be fetched from anywhere at any price. Also carries what was knowable at the time and the outcome once its horizon passed. Paid per call.

tools.name: deployer_history
tools.description: What one Arc address has launched and what became of it: pools attributed by reading each pool's own creation transaction, the share that anyone traded, the share that died and doubled once their horizons passed, the median size of a first hour and how concentrated it was, and the sell-test verdicts counted by name. Every rate states the denominator it was computed over, because the attribution is partial by design. Paid per call.

tools.name: market_context
tools.description: The Hyperliquid market now and the same hour a day ago for Bitcoin, Ether, HYPE and Solana: funding, open interest, book imbalance and mark, with the change in each, plus the widest funding gap between venues carrying each asset. The backdrop for a cent. An hour we never sampled is null rather than compared against a nearer one. Paid per call.

tools.name: carry_persistence
tools.description: How long funding spreads between Hyperliquid venues have actually lasted, over every hour sampled since 17 August 2026: the share of hours each pair stood above a level, how long an episode ran in consecutive hours, and how often the spread changed sign inside a day, which is what turns a carry into two fees and no position. This is what makes a spread sizeable rather than merely visible. Call it after hyperliquid_carry_spreads, never instead of it. Paid per call.

limit.description: How many pairs, most hours open first. Default 10.
